name: notch receptor 2

function.text: NOTCH2 encodes neurogenic locus notch homolog protein 2 [Cleaved into: Notch 2 extracellular truncation; Notch 2 intracellular domain]. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coactivator activity and signaling receptor activity. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and positive regulation of miRNA transcription.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Alagille syndrome (autosomal dominant); acroosteolysis dominant type (autosomal dominant). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Mantle cell lymphoma; Marginal zone lymphoma; Glomus tumor, malignant. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
